products.name: OhhO Pilot
products.tag: Operate any robot. From anywhere. In mixed reality.
products.desc: Mixed-reality teleoperation on any OpenXR headset. Catalog-driven robot profiles, hand-tracking arm IK, WebRTC video, dual-arm humanoid control, and per-robot calibration — any robot in your garage, one tap to drive.
products.hero: Put on an OpenXR mixed-reality headset, see your real room through passthrough, pick any robot from your OhhO garage — a mecanum mobile manipulator, a quadrotor drone, an underwater ROV, a dual-arm humanoid — and teleoperate it with controls appropriate to that robot. Hand-tracking arm IK, WebRTC telepresence video, per-robot calibration, and a catalog-driven spatial add-robot flow that mirrors the website. One shared OhhO account across web, Android and VR.
highlights: Catalog-driven — any robot, one tap to drive

specs.label: Drive schemes
specs.value: Mecanum, differential, Ackermann, aerial, thruster, legged
